subject: Chemistry
title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
summary: Atoms bond karke stable (kam energy) bante hain. Ionic bond electron transfer se (Na⁺Cl⁻), covalent bond electron sharing se (H₂, CH₄). Kossel–Lewis ka octet rule shuruaati samajh deta hai, par uske exceptions bhi hain (BF₃, PCl₅, NO).

Bond parameters — bond length, bond angle, bond enthalpy, bond order — aapas mein jude hain: bond order badhe to length ghate aur bond enthalpy badhe. Resonance aur dipole moment molecules ka asli roop aur polarity batate hain.

VSEPR theory electron pairs ke repulsion se shape batati hai (lp–lp > lp–bp > bp–bp). Valence bond theory orbitals ke overlap aur hybridisation (sp, sp², sp³, sp³d, sp³d²) se shape aur bond angles samjhati hai.

Molecular orbital theory bond order aur magnetic behaviour sahi batati hai — O₂ paramagnetic hai, jo Lewis structure nahi samjha sakta. Hydrogen bonding boiling point, solubility aur barf ke halkepan ko samjhata hai.

formulas.name: Octet rule and exceptions
formulas.formula: Atoms 8 valence electrons tak pahunchte hain;  incomplete octet: BeCl₂ (4), BF₃ (6);  odd electron: NO, NO₂;  expanded octet (3rd period onwards): PCl₅ (10), SF₆ (12)
formulas.mistake: 2nd period elements (C, N, O, F) kabhi octet expand nahi karte — d orbitals nahi hote.

formulas.name: Formal charge
formulas.formula: FC = V − L − ½B   (V = valence e⁻, L = lone-pair e⁻, B = bonding e⁻)
formulas.note: Sabse kam formal charges wala structure sabse stable.

formulas.name: Ionic bond favourable when
formulas.formula: low ionisation enthalpy (metal) + high electron gain enthalpy (non-metal) + high lattice enthalpy
formulas.note: Lattice enthalpy chhote aur zyada charge wale ions mein zyada (MgO > NaCl).

formulas.name: Fajans' rules
formulas.formula: Covalent character badhta hai jab: cation chhota, cation ka charge zyada, anion bada, cation pseudo-noble gas (18e⁻) configuration wala
formulas.note: LiCl, NaCl se zyada covalent; AlCl₃ kaafi covalent.

formulas.name: Bond order and its effects
formulas.formula: BO ↑ ⇒ bond length ↓, bond enthalpy ↑, stability ↑;  C–C 154 pm > C=C 134 pm > C≡C 120 pm

formulas.name: Resonance
formulas.formula: Asli structure sabhi canonical forms ka hybrid;  O₃, CO₃²⁻ (BO 4/3), NO₃⁻, C₆H₆;  resonance hybrid canonical forms se zyada stable
formulas.mistake: Canonical forms alag-alag exist nahi karte.

formulas.name: Dipole moment
formulas.formula: μ = q × d;  unit debye (1 D = 3.336 × 10⁻³⁰ C·m);  vector sum of bond dipoles
formulas.note: Symmetric molecules (CO₂, BF₃, CH₄, CCl₄) ka net μ = 0 chaahe bonds polar hon.

formulas.name: Percentage ionic character
formulas.formula: % ionic = (μ_observed / μ_ionic) × 100;   μ_ionic = e × d (4.8 D per Å)

formulas.name: VSEPR repulsion order
formulas.note: CH₄ 109.5° > NH₃ 107° > H₂O 104.5° — lone pairs badhne se angle ghatta hai.

formulas.name: VSEPR shapes
formulas.formula: 2 bp: linear;  3 bp: trigonal planar;  2 bp + 1 lp: bent (SO₂);  4 bp: tetrahedral;  3 bp + 1 lp: pyramidal (NH₃);  2 bp + 2 lp: bent (H₂O);  5 bp: trigonal bipyramidal (PCl₅);  4 bp + 1 lp: see-saw (SF₄);  3 bp + 2 lp: T-shape (ClF₃);  2 bp + 3 lp: linear (XeF₂, I₃⁻);  6 bp: octahedral (SF₆);  5 bp + 1 lp: square pyramidal (BrF₅);  4 bp + 2 lp: square planar (XeF₄)

formulas.name: Hybridisation shortcut
formulas.formula: H = ½(V + M − c + a)   (V = central atom ke valence e⁻, M = monovalent atoms, c = cation charge, a = anion charge);  2 sp, 3 sp², 4 sp³, 5 sp³d, 6 sp³d², 7 sp³d³
formulas.mistake: O aur S jaise divalent atoms M mein nahi gine jaate.

formulas.name: Hybrid orbitals and angles
formulas.formula: sp 180° (BeCl₂, C₂H₂);  sp² 120° (BF₃, C₂H₄);  sp³ 109.5° (CH₄);  sp³d 90°, 120° (PCl₅);  sp³d² 90° (SF₆)
formulas.note: PCl₅ mein axial bonds equatorial se lambe (zyada repulsion).

formulas.name: Sigma and pi bonds
formulas.formula: Har single bond = 1σ;  double = 1σ + 1π;  triple = 1σ + 2π;  σ head-on overlap (strong), π sideways overlap (weak)
formulas.mistake: π bond hybrid orbitals se nahi banta; s orbital π nahi banata.

formulas.name: MOT bond order and magnetism
formulas.formula: BO = ½(N_b − N_a);  BO > 0 ⇒ molecule exist kare;  unpaired e⁻ ⇒ paramagnetic

formulas.name: MO energy order
formulas.formula: Up to N₂ (14 e⁻): σ1s < σ*1s < σ2s < σ*2s < (π2pₓ = π2p_y) < σ2p_z < (π*2pₓ = π*2p_y) < σ*2p_z;   O₂, F₂: σ2p_z, π2p se neeche
formulas.note: B₂ aur O₂ paramagnetic; N₂, F₂, C₂ diamagnetic.

formulas.name: Hydrogen bonding
formulas.formula: H atom F, O, N se juda ho aur doosre F/O/N ke lone pair se attract kare;  intermolecular (H₂O, HF — high bp) aur intramolecular (o-nitrophenol — low bp, volatile)
formulas.mistake: Intramolecular H-bond boiling point badhata nahi, ghataata hai (association nahi hota).

examples.title: O₃ mein formal charge
examples.problem: O₃ ke central O par formal charge? (2 bonds — ek double, ek single — aur 1 lone pair)
examples.solution: FC = 6 − 2 − ½ × 6 = +1. Single-bonded O par −1, double-bonded O par 0.

examples.title: O₂ family ka bond order
examples.problem: O₂, O₂⁺, O₂⁻, O₂²⁻ ke bond order aur stability order?
examples.solution: O₂ = 2, O₂⁺ = 2.5, O₂⁻ = 1.5, O₂²⁻ = 1. Stability aur bond enthalpy: O₂⁺ > O₂ > O₂⁻ > O₂²⁻; bond length ulta.

examples.title: Hybridisation shortcut
examples.problem: SF₄, XeF₄, NH₄⁺ ka hybridisation aur shape?
examples.solution: SF₄: ½(6 + 4) = 5 ⇒ sp³d, see-saw (1 lp). XeF₄: ½(8 + 4) = 6 ⇒ sp³d², square planar (2 lp). NH₄⁺: ½(5 + 4 − 1) = 4 ⇒ sp³, tetrahedral.

examples.title: HCl ka % ionic character
examples.problem: HCl: μ = 1.03 D, bond length 1.27 Å. % ionic?

examples.title: σ aur π ginna
examples.problem: CH₂=CH–C≡N (acrylonitrile) mein σ aur π bonds?
examples.solution: σ: 3 C–H + C=C ka 1 + C–C 1 + C≡N ka 1 = 6. π: C=C 1 + C≡N 2 = 3.

examples.title: NH₃ vs NF₃ dipole
examples.problem: NH₃ (1.47 D) ka dipole moment NF₃ (0.23 D) se zyada kyun?
examples.solution: NH₃ mein N–H bond dipoles aur lone pair ka dipole same direction mein (jud jaate hain); NF₃ mein N–F bond dipoles lone pair ke ulta (kaat dete hain).

examples.title: N₂ aur O₂ ki magnetism
examples.problem: N₂ aur O₂ mein se kaun paramagnetic, aur kyun?
examples.solution: N₂: BO = 3, saare electrons paired ⇒ diamagnetic. O₂: π*2p mein 2 unpaired electrons ⇒ paramagnetic (Lewis structure ye nahi bata paata).

topics.title: Kossel–Lewis approach
topics.explain: Noble gases stable hain kyunki unka octet poora hai. Doosre atoms electron dekar/lekar (ionic) ya share karke (covalent) octet poora karte hain. Lewis dot structure mein valence electrons dots se dikhaate hain.

topics.title: Ionic bond aur lattice enthalpy
topics.explain: Ek mole ionic solid ko gaseous ions mein todne ki energy lattice enthalpy hai. Zyada lattice enthalpy = zyada stable solid, zyada melting point. Born–Haber cycle se nikaali jaati hai.

topics.title: Bond parameters
topics.explain: Bond length: nuclei ke beech ki doori (atom size badhe → badhe). Bond angle: central atom ke bonds ke beech ka angle. Bond enthalpy: ek mole bonds todne ki energy. Bond order: do atoms ke beech bonds ki sankhya.

topics.title: Valence bond theory
topics.explain: Bond tab banta hai jab do half-filled orbitals overlap karein aur electrons paired hon. Zyada overlap = strong bond. Overlap: s–s, s–p, p–p (σ), sideways p–p (π).

topics.title: Hybridisation ke niyam
topics.explain: Same atom ke lagbhag barabar energy wale orbitals mix hote hain; jitne orbitals mile utne hybrid orbitals bante hain; hybrid orbitals sirf σ bond aur lone pairs rakhte hain. Ethane sp³, ethene sp², ethyne sp.

topics.title: MOT ke basics
topics.explain: Atomic orbitals mil kar bonding (kam energy) aur antibonding (zyada energy) MOs banate hain. LCAO: same symmetry aur paas ki energy wale orbitals hi milte hain. He₂ ka BO 0 — exist nahi karta. H₂⁺ aur He₂⁺ ka BO 0.5.

topics.title: Electronegativity aur metallic bonding
topics.explain: Electronegativity = bond mein shared electrons ko apni taraf kheenchne ki tendency (F sabse zyada, 4.0). Do atoms ka electronegativity difference zyada (~1.7 se upar) ⇒ bond mostly ionic; kam ⇒ polar covalent; zero ⇒ non-polar. Metallic bond: positive metal ions ke beech delocalised electrons ka 'sea' — isliye metals conductor, malleable aur ductile hote hain.

topics.title: Hydrogen bond ke effects
topics.explain: HF, H₂O, NH₃ ke boiling points apne group ke baaki hydrides se zyada. Barf mein open cage structure ⇒ paani se halki. Alcohols, carboxylic acids paani mein ghulte hain. Proteins aur DNA ki structure H-bonds par tiki hai.

ratta: Fajans: chhota cation, zyada charge, bada anion ⇒ zyada covalent.
lp–lp > lp–bp > bp–bp;  CH₄ 109.5° > NH₃ 107° > H₂O 104.5°.
H = ½(V + M − c + a): 2 sp, 3 sp², 4 sp³, 5 sp³d, 6 sp³d².
SF₄ see-saw, ClF₃ T-shape, XeF₂ linear, XeF₄ square planar, BrF₅ square pyramidal.
BO = ½(N_b − N_a);  O₂ & B₂ paramagnetic.
μ = 0: CO₂, BF₃, CH₄, CCl₄;  NH₃ > NF₃.
